Full firstLevelLawsJVM regression on the certified compact precision candidate passed 83/84 tests. The remaining ConditionMilestoneSuite LWU calibration refuses before any family evaluation or decoder: 321 fine samples x (14x9x7 training nodes) x 10 jet components = 2,831,220 training-matrix cells, above KernelBasisBudget.MaxArrayCells=2,000,000.

This is an existing source/policy mismatch: the suite, kernel compiler/budget and LWU family are byte-identical to baseline 0a99c499. Frozen Gaussian compact cohort and full fit JVM/JS gates pass. Full JS first-level counterpart is being retained separately; no whole-module green claim is made.

Do not silently coarsen the frozen LWU/C0 inputs, remove/skip the test, raise its scientific tolerances, or increase global resource limits. Resolve with an explicit bounded compiler capacity/implementation route consistent with standalone Gale ownership, or a separately declared and qualified change to the frozen compilation plan. Preserve decoder limits and prove numerical accuracy plus actual storage/work admission on JVM and Scala.js.

Evidence: docs/verification/linux-cohort-precision-20261006; /private/tmp/scalafim-compact-paired-adapter-packet-20261006/first-level-lwu-resource-failure.json; complete raw first-level logs will be sealed after both platforms finish. This remains a blocker to main publication independently of the Linux21/24 compact cohort repair.
